ns2:course.label: Environmental Economics
ns2:course.description: Economic issues surrounding environmental quality, including: costs and benefits of environmental protection; economics of environmental policies (such as those dealing with toxics, water, and air pollution, and municipal solid waste); and economics of international environmental problems (such as ozone depletion and climate change). Same as ECON 210, ENVS 210, NRES 210, and UP 210.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as ECON 210, ENVS 210, NRES 210, and UP 210.
